actual_status_queries: Before and after each site-survey, the command read the WifiMaster radio interface. Before and after the 5GHz survey it additionally read WifiMaster1/WifiStation0. The saved sanitized status fields include the master and station only.
not_captured: The survey runs did not query separate access-point interfaces or preserve separate AP child status. Earlier plan wording that implied before/after AP status was captured is corrected; no AP continuity conclusion is supported by these status snapshots.
